instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Swedish tweet express or imply, including through what they choose to share: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Judge the poster's stance, including the stance implied by what they share or retweet. Sharing harm, scandal, criticism of politicians or parties, sarcasm, pointed rhetorical questions and complaints is negative even in a factual tone. Sharing good news, achievements, tips, offers, invitations, recommendations and warm or excited remarks is positive even when it is understated. Neutral is for content with no good or bad slant: dry facts, everyday questions and logistics, automatic posts, and plain agreement or reflection.

neutral.what: Dry facts without a good or bad slant, everyday questions, plans and logistics, automatic posts, plain agreement or reflections.
examples: @powerpuff_ronja vad ska du läsa? (what are you going to study?)
@CarlssonJhannes Absolut. Jag förstår den ståndpunkten och respekterar den med. (Absolutely. I understand that position and respect it too.)
Nu har vi ändrat priset igen: E85: 9,44 B95: 14,53 Diesel: 14,27 (We have changed the price again)
neutral.cues: vad/hur/när (what/how/when), prices, times, Jag gillade ett videoklipp (I liked a video), Absolut (Absolutely)
neutral.not_for: Headlines about crime, disasters, scandals or failures are negative. Questions to politicians that imply criticism are negative.

positive.what: Joy, praise, love, gratitude, excitement, humour aimed warmly; sharing good news, successes, offers, events, tips and recommendations; approval of a party or person.
examples: Gratis böcker på föreläsningen http://t.co/DClFqxjJIY (Free books at the lecture)

RT @JesperHellsten: Sedan 2006 har mer än 300 000 fler människor ett jobb att gå till och det är faktiskt bara början! #sparkaintemig #svpo… (Since 2006, more than 300,000 more people have a job to go to, and it is actually just the beginning!)
@papperferdinand grattis till ert giftemål det var ett vackert bröllop :,) (congrats on your marriage, it was a beautiful wedding)
positive.cues: grattis (congrats), tips, gratis (free), kom! (come!), bästa (best), bra (good), härligt (lovely), älskar (love), :), ;), <3, haha
positive.not_for: Ironic praise ('Tur att...', Lucky that...) is negative. An automatic 'Jag gillade ett videoklipp' (I liked a video) post is neutral.

negative.what: Anger, sadness, frustration, complaints, insults, mockery, sarcasm; criticism of politicians, parties or society; sharing harm, scandals or bad news.
examples: RT @gustavgelin: Just nu röstar Sveriges Riksdag in en rasist, fascist och homfob till en vice talmanspost. (Right now the Riksdag is voting a racist, fascist and homophobe into a deputy speaker post.)
Coop återkallar hamburgare efter salmonellalarm: Coop återkallar frysta hamburgare, av märket Coop, s... http://t.co/H1WPM0fuXD #nyheter (Coop recalls hamburgers after salmonella alarm)

RT @fredrik_t_k: Tur att bara tre av fyra laddplatser i Vällingbygaraget var upptagna av fossilbilar... #elbil #swegreen http://t.co/naXqX0… (Lucky that only three of four charging spots were taken by fossil cars...)
negative.cues: hatar (hate), jävla/fan (damn), sorgligt (sad), jobbigt (annoying), rasist (racist), kris (crisis), sämre (worse), :(, 😭, ironic 'tur att' (lucky that)
negative.not_for: Swearing used for enthusiasm ('SÅ. JÄVLA. BRA', SO. DAMN. GOOD) is positive. Teasing among friends with ;) or haha is usually positive.
